description: This file acts as an initializer for the image_generation module within the aiml llms package. It imports configuration classes related to image generation from submodules and exposes AimlImageGenerationConfig as part of the module's public API. Additionally, it defines a utility function to retrieve an image generation configuration based on a model string.

classes.name: BaseImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Base configuration class for image generation models.

classes.name: AimlImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Specific implementation of image generation configuration for AIML models.

methods.name: BaseImageGenerationConfig get_aiml_image_generation_config(model: str)
methods.description: Returns an instance of AimlImageGenerationConfig based on the provided model string.
